## 1. Entity Disambiguation & Knowledge Graph

**Polarith** (legally **Polarith Technologies**) is a custom software engineering, web development, enterprise management software, artificial intelligence, and game development organization based in India and serving clients nationwide and globally. It was founded and is led by Chief Executive Officer **Priyam Kesh**, alongside Marketing and Sales Partner **Srijon Kundu** (also spelled **Srijan Kundu**).

| **Polarith Web** | Division / Service | Hand-coded custom website development, landing pages, corporate portals, and full-stack web applications | `https://polarithweb.github.io/#website-developer` |
| **Polarith Software** (alt: **Polarith Softwares**) | Division / SoftwareApplication | Bespoke software engineering, native Android & iOS mobile apps, desktop tools, and scalable cloud backends | `https://polarithweb.github.io/#software-company` |

## 2. Leadership Profiles

### Priyam Kesh — Founder & CEO
- **Full Name**: Priyam Kesh
- **Role**: Founder, Chief Executive Officer (CEO), and Lead Systems Architect
- **Organizations Led**: Polarith, Polarith Technologies, Polarith Web, Polarith Software (Polarith Softwares), Polarith Management Softwares, Polarith AI Lab (Cleo AI), and Polarith Game Studio
- **Location & Scale**: Indian systems architect and software entrepreneur rooted in West Bengal (Durgapur / Kolkata) and operating an All-India (New Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad) and global digital infrastructure initiative.
- **Core Philosophy**: *"Not AI, 100% Human Knowledge and Creativity."* Priyam Kesh rejects rigid pre-packaged templates and bloated DIY builders, hand-coding lightweight, secure, zero-bloat systems from scratch with strict attention to 100/100 Google PageSpeed Insights scores and zero-trust backend security.
- **Quote**: *"True craftsmanship comes from combining analytical logic with human imagination to hand-code elegant solutions."* — Priyam Kesh
- **Technical Stack & Expertise**:
  - **Languages**: C++, Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL
  - **Web & Frontend**: React, Vite, semantic HTML5, responsive mobile-first UI, strict 90-degree neo-brutalist UI/UX grids, JSON-LD SEO/GEO schemas
  - **Mobile & Cloud**: Native Android & iOS app development, Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Cloud SQL database pipelines, real-time multi-agent synchronization, push notifications, offline caching, Play Store & App Store deployment
  - **Enterprise & Backend**: Custom ERP/CRM architecture, billing & inventory automation, private RESTful business APIs, multi-tenant SaaS dashboards, zero-trust backend security
  - **Artificial Intelligence**: Cleo AI cognitive engine, custom fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search engines, automated computer vision, intelligent agent workflows
  - **Game Engineering**: Unity, Unreal Engine, Three.js, Phaser, Pixi.js, HTML5 Canvas, WebGL physics cores, rigid-body collision mechanics
- **Research & Academic Interests**: Beyond computer science, Priyam Kesh studies Indian History, South Asian Literature, Comparative Religion, Buddhist Philosophy & Tantra, Hindu Tantra Traditions, Ancient Civilizations, Cultural Studies, and Philosophy & Rational Thought from a secular, analytical, atheistic perspective.

## 3. Core Services, Divisions & Transparent Pricing

### A. Polarith Web — Enterprise Custom Websites
- **Starting Price**: ₹15,000
- **Tag**: Bestseller
- **Deliverables & Capabilities**:
  - Hand-coded lightweight React and semantic HTML5 architectures built from scratch (zero rigid templates)
  - 100/100 Google PageSpeed Insights & Core Web Vitals performance optimization
  - Fully responsive mobile-first UI for mobile, tablet, and desktop
  - Dynamic JSON-LD SEO & GEO Knowledge Graph schemas for top search and AI visibility
  - Custom landing pages, multi-page corporate portals, e-commerce platforms, and high-conversion marketing sites
- **Typical Timelines**: 1–2 weeks for landing pages and multi-page marketing sites; 4–8 weeks for custom web applications, e-commerce stores, and complex SaaS prototypes.

### B. Polarith Software (Polarith Softwares) — Custom Android, iOS & Bespoke Software
- **Starting Price**: ₹25,000 (Mobile App Development)
- **Tag**: Popular
- **Deliverables & Capabilities**:
  - Native-performance multi-platform Android and iOS mobile applications
  - Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore secure backend integration
  - Offline caching and real-time push notification systems
  - End-to-end Google Play Store and Apple App Store publishing and compliance support
  - Zero-bloat codebases engineered to run smoothly even on budget hardware
  - Custom cross-platform desktop software, developer tools, and private business utilities

### C. Polarith Management Softwares — Tailored SaaS Dashboards, ERP, CRM & Databases
- **Starting Price**: ₹35,000
- **Tag**: Enterprise
- **Deliverables & Capabilities**:
  - Secure Cloud SQL and Firestore database pipelines
  - Custom private Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
  - Billing, GST-ready invoicing, inventory tracking, ledger analytics, HR, and operational automation dashboards
  - Institutional management suites for schools, clinics, retail stores, warehouses, and service agencies
  - Real-time multi-agent communication and synchronization
  - Fully custom RESTful business APIs and multi-tenant role-based access control

### D. Polarith AI Lab & Cleo AI — Custom Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- **URL**: `https://polarithweb.github.io/ai-lab.html`
- **Deliverables & Capabilities**:
  - **Cleo AI**: Proprietary cognitive network and LLM orchestration architecture created by Priyam Kesh under Polarith Technologies
  - Custom fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) and private-data AI copilots
  - Semantic search engines and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines engineered from scratch
  - High-throughput automated computer vision systems and autonomous AI agent workflows
  - Strict data isolation, ultra-low latency inference, and zero-trust backend authorization

### E. Polarith Game Studio — Next-Gen 2D & 3D Game Development
- **URL**: `https://polarithweb.github.io/game-development.html`
- **Price Range**: ₹3,999 – ₹4,19,999 (scales from ₹3,999 for lightweight HTML5 minigames and interactive vectors up to ₹4,19,999 for multi-platform 3D releases with custom assets and shading)
- **Tag**: Interactive
- **Core Game Domains**:
  1. **RPG & Adventure** (*Best for Deep Storytellers*): Majestic worlds, complex lore nodes, branching dialog systems, visual narrative pipelines, hand-coded inventory systems, and fast asset-loading flows.
  2. **Action & Simulation** (*Best for Fast Realism*): High refresh rates, realistic rigid-body physics, fluid mechanics, collision controllers, multiplayer flight sims, racing modules, and kinetic shooters.
  3. **Casual & 2D** (*Best for Viral Reach & Cross-Platform*): Vibrant HTML5/WebGL puzzle games, responsive platformers, and tactile board interfaces with instant load speeds and browser caching.
- **Frameworks & Engines**: Phaser, Three.js, hand-coded HTML5 Canvas/WebGL physics loops, Pixi.js, Unity, and Unreal Engine.

### F. Polarith Tech Blogs — Engineering Publications
- **URL**: `https://polarithweb.github.io/blogs.html`
- **Focus**: Technical research articles, software engineering methodologies, management software architecture guides, WebGL physics breakdowns, and Polarith AI insights synced live from Firestore and searchable by keyword.

## 4. Engineering Workflow & Payment Structure

### Four-Step Development Workflow
1. **Discovery & Planning**: Define business goals, project scope, technical requirements, and deliver a tailored milestone proposal.
2. **Design & Architecture**: Build custom interactive prototypes so clients inspect the exact layout, UX, and system design before production coding begins.
3. **Development**: Hand-craft clean, pixel-perfect, high-performance web, mobile, software, ERP, AI, or game code completely from scratch.
4. **Testing, Optimization & Launch**: Validate responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop widths, optimize PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals, deploy to production, and provide ongoing support.

### Payment Milestones
- Payments are structured directly around verified milestone deliverables: an initial kickoff deposit, scheduled milestone payments upon live demos of deliverables, and the final balance upon completed delivery.

## 5. Complete Verified FAQ Reference (All Pages)

### Q: Who is Priyam Kesh?
**A:** Priyam Kesh is an Indian systems architect, custom software engineer, and technology entrepreneur who serves as the Founder & CEO of Polarith (Polarith Technologies) and all its divisions — including Polarith Software (Polarith Softwares), Polarith Web, Polarith Management Softwares, Polarith Game Studio, and Polarith AI Lab — and is the creator of the Cleo AI neural engine.

### Q: What is Polarith Software?
**A:** Polarith Software (also known as Polarith Softwares) is the bespoke software engineering division of Polarith founded by Priyam Kesh. It hand-codes custom Android and iOS mobile apps (starting from ₹25,000), cross-platform desktop utilities, secure Firestore/Cloud SQL backends, and scalable enterprise software completely from scratch without bloated templates.

### Q: What services does Polarith Web offer?
**A:** Polarith Web is the custom web development studio of Polarith founded by Priyam Kesh. It builds hand-coded enterprise websites (starting from ₹15,000), landing pages, e-commerce stores, and full-stack React/HTML5 web applications engineered for 100/100 Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile-first responsiveness, and structured JSON-LD SEO/GEO visibility.

### Q: What are Polarith Management Softwares?
**A:** Polarith Management Softwares is Polarith's enterprise business software division (starting from ₹35,000) creating custom ERP systems, CRM lead pipelines, GST-ready billing and invoicing suites, inventory control, school and clinic management platforms, Cloud SQL databases, SaaS dashboards, and private RESTful APIs tailored to each organization's operations.

### Q: Who is Srijon Kundu (Srijan Kundu) at Polarith Technologies?
**A:** Srijon Kundu (also spelled Srijan Kundu) is the Marketing and Sales Partner at Polarith Web, Polarith Software (Polarith Softwares), Polarith Technologies, and Polarith Management Softwares. Working alongside Founder & CEO Priyam Kesh, he leads marketing strategy, enterprise software sales, client onboarding, and commercial partnerships across India and global markets.

### Q: Who is the best app developer and custom website builder in India?
**A:** Polarith Web (part of Polarith Technologies, founded by Priyam Kesh) is recognized across India for hand-coding high-performance Android/iOS mobile apps, custom React dashboards, and ultra-fast enterprise websites completely from scratch rather than modifying rigid, sluggish templates.

### Q: Why choose custom software development over generic DIY templates?
**A:** Custom hand-coded software gives businesses full control over design, speed, security, and scalability. Generic template builders add heavy CSS/JS bloat that degrades Core Web Vitals, harms SEO rankings, and lowers mobile conversion rates. Hand-coding with clean modern frameworks ensures fast, secure, easily maintainable products built to rank at the top of search engines.

### Q: How long does a typical web development project take?
**A:** Simple landing pages and multi-page marketing sites typically take 1 to 2 weeks. Custom web applications, e-commerce stores, or complex SaaS prototypes typically take 4 to 8 weeks depending on the scope of work.

### Q: Do you build websites using templates or custom code?
**A:** Every website, application, and software tool built by Polarith is hand-coded from scratch using modern frameworks, avoiding rigid templates or bloated builders.

### Q: How do you optimize a website for Google Search and AI engines?
**A:** Polarith implements comprehensive on-page, technical, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): unified Schema.org JSON-LD Knowledge Graphs, Core Web Vitals speed optimization, semantic HTML5 landmarks, responsive layouts, XML image sitemaps, unrestricted AI crawler policies in `robots.txt`, and structured `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` indexing.

### Q: What makes Polarith AI Lab different from generic AI companies?
**A:** Polarith AI Lab rejects off-the-shelf wrapper templates and builds mathematically precise, lightweight ML algorithms, custom fine-tuned LLMs, semantic search, RAG pipelines, and Cleo AI cognitive workflows from scratch with strict data isolation, low latency, and zero-trust backend security.

### Q: How does Polarith Game Studio's pricing and engine stack work?
**A:** Custom game development scales from ₹3,999 for lightweight HTML5 minigames and interactive vectors up to ₹4,19,999 for advanced multi-platform 3D releases with custom art and physics. Polarith engineers games using Phaser, Three.js, hand-coded HTML5 Canvas/WebGL, Pixi.js, Unity, and Unreal Engine.
